message.realcinema.projector_busy: The projector must be off and empty
message.realcinema.burner_busy: The burner is busy or already loaded
message.realcinema.need_roll: Insert an empty film reel first
message.realcinema.need_reference: Set a video reference first (use a renamed item)
message.realcinema.too_short: This film is too short to cut
message.realcinema.film_cut: Film cut: two reels of %s s
message.realcinema.video_missing: Video file not found: %s (put it in realcinema_videos/)
message.realcinema.video_slow: This video decodes slower than real time. Use a smaller file (720p or less).
message.realcinema.video_large: Large video (over 720p): it may stutter. 720p or less is recommended.
message.realcinema.video_audio_pns: Audio track not readable (unsupported AAC feature). Re-encode: ffmpeg -c:a aac
message.realcinema.join_need_two: Hold a second reel in the other hand to join
message.realcinema.cannot_join: These reels do not belong together (other video or not adjacent)
message.realcinema.canister_need_roll: Hold a film reel in the other hand
message.realcinema.no_projector_ready: No projector with a film reel in range
jei.realcinema.info.projector: Shows a film reel on a cinema screen. Right-click opens its screen: reel slot, play, pause, stop and progress. Right-click with a written reel inserts it directly; sneak + right-click starts/stops quickly. It looks for a screen up to 32 blocks in front of it. A control panel or clapperboard also starts it.
jei.realcinema.info.film_cutter: Right-click with a written reel to cut it in the middle into two reels (two parts of the same video). Sneak with a reel in each hand to join two adjoining parts again.
jei.realcinema.info.film_burner: 1) Right-click with an empty reel. 2) Right-click with an item renamed in an anvil: the name is the video reference (file name or link). 3) Click with an empty hand to burn (5 s). 4) Click again to take the written reel.
jei.realcinema.info.cinema_screen: Place several side by side and stacked to form one large surface (up to 16x16). One click opens or closes the curtains of all connected blocks. Its front must face the projector.
jei.realcinema.info.speaker_wall: Switched on by a control panel within 8 blocks while a film is playing. Click to toggle by hand.
jei.realcinema.info.speaker_floor: Switched on by a control panel within 8 blocks while a film is playing. Click to toggle by hand.
jei.realcinema.info.control_panel: Click: start all projectors with a reel within 8 blocks and switch on speakers; click again: pause; sneak-click: stop. It does nothing without a projector holding a reel. At the end of the film it resets itself.
jei.realcinema.info.cinema_seat: Click to fold the seat up or down.
jei.realcinema.info.popcorn_machine: Click to start or stop popping.
jei.realcinema.info.film_roll_empty: Put it into a film burner to write a video reference onto it.
jei.realcinema.info.film_roll_written: Carries a video reference, a length and a start point. Insert it into a projector. Cut and join it at a film cutter.
jei.realcinema.info.film_roll_loaded: The written reel while it sits in a projector. It turns back into a written reel when ejected.
jei.realcinema.info.film_canister: Holds up to 8 reels. Right-click takes the last one out; sneak + right-click with a reel in the other hand puts it in. In the inventory it works like a bundle.
jei.realcinema.info.clapperboard: Right-click claps (everyone sees and hears it) and operates the nearest control panel within 8 blocks: start; sneak + clap: stop.
